newsitem.title: FINLAND: ASKO SELLS SHARES IN UNIT FOR FIM 100 MLN.
newsitem.headline: ASKO SELLS SHARES IN UNIT FOR FIM 100 MLN.

text.p: Finnish furniture and plastic pipe maker Asko Oy said on Wednesday it had sold 40 percent of votes in its real estate company Tampereen Kiinteisto Invest Oy for 100 million markka to three insurance companies.

"The buyers are Nova (25 percent), Elake-Sampo (10 percent) and Elake-Varma (five percent)," Asko said in a statement, adding that it still holds 46.7 percent of votes in Tampereen Kiinteisto Invest after the deal.
Elake-Sampo is part of Sampo group.
Tampereen Kiinteisto Invest holds old industrial buildings in the city of Tampere.
The deal was part of the programme the target of which is to reduce Asko's real estate holdings, Asko said.
